newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed in sleepy dealings.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed in sleepy dealings.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed mixed as traders complained of extremely slow, choppy dealings.
"There's still not a lot of hedging going on because there's just no (farmer) selling," a MGE broker said. "So we're just following Chicago and Kansas City."
Nearby MGE spring wheat claimed some support from a technical bounce in CBOT soybeans and corn.
MGE spring wheat closed one cent per bushel lower to two cents higher, with December up 1/4 cent at $4.18-1/2. March gained 1-1/2 cents at $4.04-1/2.
The MGE December/March inverse narrowed slightly in what traders said was an adjustment to Friday's wider close.
Traders said Wilson Trading bought one million Dec bushels and 600,000 March. Atwood Peavey sold two million March.
The MGE estimated Monday's spring wheat futures volume at 14.412 million bushels, versus Friday's volume of 18.765 million.
MGE barley settled four to five cents per cwt higher, with Dec up five cents at $7.00.
